env.name: NODE_ENV
env.description: Express runtime mode; controls verbose error output.

env.name: PORT
env.description: TCP port the HTTP server binds to.

env.name: HOST
env.description: Network interface to bind. Use 0.0.0.0 inside containers.

env.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated list of CORS origins permitted to call the API.

env.name: API_KEY_SECRET
env.description: 32-byte random secret used to sign issued API keys. Rotate periodically.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL connection string. When unset the in-memory storage backend is used (development only).

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.description: Redis connection string for distributed idempotency storage.

env.name: NODE_ENV
env.description: Pino transport selection and verbose logging gating.

env.name: PORT
env.description: Read-only payment-status API port.

env.name: HOST
env.description: Bind interface.

env.name: TON_NETWORK
env.description: Selects the TON network the indexer subscribes to.

env.name: TON_API_ENDPOINT
env.description: TonCenter (or compatible) JSON-RPC endpoint.

env.name: TON_API_KEY
env.description: TonCenter API key. Required for production rate limits.

env.name: PAYMENT_HUB_ADDRESS
env.description: Bech32-encoded address of the deployed PaymentHub contract.

env.name: MERCHANT_PAYMENT_HUB_ADDRESS
env.description: Address of the deployed MerchantPaymentHub contract.

env.name: NFT_COLLECTION_7777_ADDRESS
env.description: Address of the 7777 (consumer) NFT collection.

env.name: NFT_COLLECTION_8888_ADDRESS
env.description: Address of the 8888 (merchant) NFT collection.

env.name: DB_PATH
env.description: Filesystem path for the SQLite database. Must reside on a persistent volume in production.

env.name: INDEXER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
env.description: Interval in milliseconds between RPC poll cycles.

env.name: INDEXER_BATCH_SIZE
env.description: Maximum number of blocks fetched per poll cycle.

env.name: INDEXER_CONFIRMATION_BLOCKS
env.description: Number of additional blocks required before an event is marked confirmed (reorg protection).

env.name: REDIS_HOST
env.description: Hostname of Redis used for distributed rate limiting. Leave blank to disable.

env.name: REDIS_PORT
env.description: Redis TCP port.

env.name: REDIS_PASSWORD
env.description: Redis AUTH password (optional).

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Pino log level.

env.name: LOG_PRETTY
env.description: Enable pino-pretty transport. MUST be false in production for JSON logs.
